examples.en: I knew you were a romantic.

examples.text: Creo que has leído demasiadas novelas románticas.
examples.en: I think you've read too many romance novels.

examples.text: María dice siempre que Tom no es lo suficientemente romántico.
examples.en: Mary is always saying that Tom isn't romantic enough.

examples.text: Sólo quiero hacerte saber que yo tengo una cita romántica.
examples.en: I just wanted to let you know I have a date.
